zh_words.txt.gz is derived from its dictionary jieba/dict.txt (commit 67fa2e36e72f69d9134b8a1037b83fbb070b9775, blob
fc6075f64943e1861c420db4da38063de9d8afc5); the changes are listed in the file's header and in tools/build_zh_words.py.
No jieba code is used: text.py has its own segmenter.
